opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: The air is hot with tension as we approach the camp

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: Macduff had mentioned how Malcolm had formed an army in an attempt to remove Macbeth from his unrightful place on the throne.

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: We, the elite of Havenus, have been sent for other reasons, however.

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: We have been sent to find and destroy the spectral core within the area. My job is to manage these 12 elite to perform the job... I've only got this job in a short amount of time...

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: ...This is the most dysfunctional bunch of people i've ever seen.

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: For starters, Romeo acts like a childish loner and keeps mopping about his lost 'Juliet'... whoever that may be.

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: Antonia doesn't even act like a member of the team, all she cares about is money in her pockets.

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: While there are some who act more professional, like Snowball or George, Goole and Sherlock don't even look like they're here to help us

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: And Macduff has been acting weird ever since we got to this sector, said something about a kid or something.

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: I wish Stan was here, he's better at keeping them in check than I am, like he did when...

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: Suddenly, I hear a loud crash from a distance.

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: The Monster had just crushed the skull of a Guillevien solider, to the shock of Macduff and Racheal, who were trying to negotiate with Malcolm and Rosses forces.

opening.speaker: Jasmine
opening.dialogue: What the hell do you think your doing!?!?

opening.speaker: The Monster
opening.dialogue: ...They were talking to much about honour and glory... I despise those who gloat and don't get to the point.

opening.speaker: Macduff
opening.dialogue: That doesn't matter. We're here for a purpose, and that purpose is to...

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: Macduff was cut off by the other present soldiers, who had surrounded our group with their weapons drawn.

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: It seems that negotiation will no longer be posible.

opening.speaker: The Monster
opening.dialogue: Brilliant.

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: The Monster charges at the Guillevien forces, with some of the other battle ready elite following behind him.

opening.speaker: Narration
opening.dialogue: Kyla walks over to me

opening.speaker: Kyla
opening.dialogue: Apologies. This is how it usually is.

opening.speaker: Jasmine
opening.dialogue: ...This is going to be a long day, isn't it?

the pyros.speaker: Narration
the pyros.dialogue: After a long battle, we've finally defeated all the soldiers within the area, although a few had escaped to warn their leaders.

the pyros.speaker: Narration
the pyros.dialogue: Now that we can catch our breath, I finally move towards the Monster to finally figure out what the reason was for his actions.

the pyros.speaker: Narration
the pyros.dialogue: However, someone had beaten me to him... with a different approach than I had expected.

the pyros.speaker: Snowball
the pyros.dialogue: Mighty Beast, what was your reasoning for attacking the Guillevien forces?

the pyros.speaker: Narration
the pyros.dialogue: The Monster looks at Snowball, who had been beside him carrying the head of one of the soldiers.

the pyros.speaker: The Monster
the pyros.dialogue: ...They pissed me off, with all their gloating and braggin of how they killed... inhuman 'monsters' they called pyros. I despise people like that.

the pyros.speaker: Narration
the pyros.dialogue: The Monster looks towards his hand, which was covered in blood, and then back at Snowball.

the pyros.speaker: The Monster
the pyros.dialogue: ...Man is a simple creature. They care only about themselves, and their own selfish desires, and if they don't like something they make, they cast it away without a second thought... a cruel process of thought.

the pyros.speaker: Narration
the pyros.dialogue: Snowball exhaled slowly, and then looked at the Monster again.

the pyros.speaker: Snowball
the pyros.dialogue: I understand. To be cast out is a cruel thing, expecially if it from does you loved...

the pyros.speaker: Narration
the pyros.dialogue: She fell silent after saying that.

the pyros.speaker: Kyla
the pyros.dialogue: I beilieve that that should be that problem done with. Now, we still have a job to comple...

the pyros.speaker: Narration
the pyros.dialogue: Kyla was cut off by the sound of stomping coming from the distance, then the smell of smoke.

the pyros.speaker: Macduff
the pyros.dialogue: Pyros...

the pyros.speaker: Jasmine
the pyros.dialogue: Pyros?

the pyros.speaker: Macduff
the pyros.dialogue: Creatures of pure fire. They are usually cooperative, but with the amount of footsteps... Their's no doubt about it. This is a search crew.

the pyros.speaker: Narration
the pyros.dialogue: A figure could be seen in the distance, with a group of Pyros following behind it. The figure was young wearing a red cloak, and had a flaming sword in its hand.

the pyros.speaker: George
the pyros.dialogue: The Flare Sword. Such a powerful weapon... this is no normal search party.

the pyros.speaker: Lenuff
the pyros.dialogue: So, this is where the knight's set up camp. So who are these people?

the pyros.speaker: Narration
the pyros.dialogue: Macduff's face turned pale as he looked at the figure in the distance.

the pyros.speaker: Lenuff
the pyros.dialogue: Ahh, no matter. We'll just follow normal procedure. ahemm...

the pyros.speaker: Narration
the pyros.dialogue: Lenuff pulled out a note from his pocket, and began to read it aloud.

the pyros.speaker: Lenuff
the pyros.dialogue: George, The Sand Hammer? Is he among you?

the pyros.speaker: Lenuff
the pyros.dialogue: I see... You certainly don't give off the aura of a high ranked supressor, so i'll be putting you in for identity theft. So next would be...

the pyros.speaker: Narration
the pyros.dialogue: Lenuff paused for a bit, looking as if they had loosely remembered something, then continued.

the pyros.speaker: Lenuff
the pyros.dialogue: Macduff the traitor... I see that your here as well. Well, I would have left you off with a warning, but I simply cannot ignore both a psychopath and a traitor. So, the punishment shall be summary execution.

the pyros.speaker: Narration
the pyros.dialogue: Lenuff raised their sword, and the Pyros behind them began to charge at us.

the pyros.speaker: Narration
the pyros.dialogue: We had no choice but to fight back, and so we did.

the pyros 1.speaker: Lenuff
the pyros 1.dialogue: Useless soldiers. I should have known a simple search party wouldn't get such a job done.

the pyros 1.speaker: Lenuff
the pyros 1.dialogue: If you want somthing done right...

the pyros 1.speaker: Narration
the pyros 1.dialogue: Macduff had returned with a sword slash of his own as the duel begins.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Lenuff staggers, falling down to the ground with his sword falling beside him.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Sherlock walked up to the boy, gun in hand, and aimed it at the boy's head.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Sherlock
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: ...It seems you've lost. And a duel to the death means that you must lose your life. Please close you eyes, it should make it less pai...

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Sherlock was shoudler bashed by Macduff, being knocked away

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Macduff then turned to the boy, and raised his sword, ready to strike.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Macduff
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: ...Find solitude in death to the blade, young soul...

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Lenuff
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: So there is still honour in that heart of yours... Well, I accept my death if it be from a true warrior.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Lenuff
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: YOU ARE NOT THAT

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Lenuff raised his sword, and swung it at Macduff, who was ready to block it.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: However, the sword was too fast for Macduff to react, and it pierced through his chest.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Macduff fell to the ground, blood pouring from his wound.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Lenuff then turned to us, and raised his sword, ready to strike.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Lenuff
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: ...Now, for the rest of you. I have given you a chance to think. If I find you again, I will not be merciful.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Lenuff then turned and ran off.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Jasmine
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: ...Well. I haven't had a chance to use it yet, but I guess now is the time.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: I remove a key from my pocket, before thrusting it into the ground as suddenly, all of Macduff's and the rest of the elites wounds had healed.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: The world key, the strongest relic in the world, with the ability to heal any wounds and even raise people from the dead, at the cost of the user experiencing the pain of the wounds themselves.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Due to my link with the 12, the pain was much less profound than it would have been for a normal person, but it was still enough to make me fall to the ground.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Even a graze from that sword's pain cut down was that powerful, and I could only imagine how much pain Macduff had felt when he was struck.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Sherlock
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Would you like to explain youself, swordsman?

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Macduff
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: What exactly do you need explained?

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Sherlock put's is gun away and pulls a book out of his pocket with the symbol of a tree with three long falling branches on it.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Sherlock
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Rule number 145 of Enlightenment: 'The first person to approach a fighter that is unable to continue a duel to the death must be the one to finish the job.' I'm sure you known this already.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Romeo
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: ...That's a stupid rule.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Romeo, who was usually moppy and reserved, seemed to assertively retort Sherlock's claim.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Romeo
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: He started the duel against Macduff, Macduff should be the one to finish said duel.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Goole
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Well, that is the rule, and that is that. Unless, ofcourse, you can give a rule that goes against that

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Linda
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Y'all are going on about duels and rules and stuff, in my opinion the guy who did the most fightin should get the kill.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Tia
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Can we stop talking about death and duels and get on with this

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Sherlock
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Not until Macduff admit's his own wrongdoings

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: As the 11 of them bicker amongst themselves, Macduff looks towards the distance where Lenuff ran

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Suddenly, a dark purple cloud encases the area around us.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Kyla
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: A spectral zone has formed. The spectres will move towards the direction of the spectral core. We must follow them

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Sherlock looks towards Kyla, sigh, then puts the book back in his pocket.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Sherlock
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: I suppose our duty comes first, after all.

a spectral zone 1.speaker: Kyla
a spectral zone 1.dialogue: Be prepared to fight them off as we follow

a spectral zone 1.1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.1.dialogue: We continue to fight off more and more spectres as we began conversing amongst ourselves

a spectral zone 1.1.speaker: Jasmine
a spectral zone 1.1.dialogue: So, why does Havenus want the spectral core destroyed anyways.

a spectral zone 1.1.speaker: Kyla
a spectral zone 1.1.dialogue: These ghouls formed from the spectral core are the souls of the dead. Havenus want's them gone to stay in business as the only method of TRUE revival in the crater

a spectral zone 1.1.speaker: Kyla
a spectral zone 1.1.dialogue: We, the elite, have been promised the ability to bring back someone of our choosing if we successfully destroy these cores

a spectral zone 1.1.speaker: Antonia
a spectral zone 1.1.dialogue: That's what they promised you guy's. I was promised tons of cash for this job

a spectral zone 1.1.speaker: Sherlock
a spectral zone 1.1.dialogue: Well, I am here because it is my duty to solve the 'case' of the spectral cores... I've realised now what that will entail

a spectral zone 1.1.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.1.dialogue: We continue onwards, as the ghouls led the way

a spectral zone 1.2.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.2.dialogue: We reach where the last of the ghouls are heading, only to not find the spectral core, but to see a man sitting on a rock looking in the direction of the castle of flames

a spectral zone 1.2.speaker: Jasmine
a spectral zone 1.2.dialogue: ...Guys... I don't think this is the spectral core

a spectral zone 1.2.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.2.dialogue: Out of everything they told me before I was put as the leader of this group, This was the phenomena I was clued in about the most

a spectral zone 1.2.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.2.dialogue: If a souls emotions are strong enough at their time of death, they will become a raidrunner, an empowered ghoul to lead the weaker ones

a spectral zone 1.2.speaker: Ghost of Banquo
a spectral zone 1.2.dialogue: Halt, travelers. You may not continue. Your path to the castle shall not be successful, for no man born of woman can kill Macbeth.

a spectral zone 1.2.speaker: Macduff
a spectral zone 1.2.dialogue: Yes... He was a great friend to Macbeth, yet was killed by three rogue murderers

a spectral zone 1.2.speaker: Ghost of Banquo
a spectral zone 1.2.dialogue: The bastard couldn't even kill me himself, like a true man would. Instead, he sent assassins to kill me and my son. Such a man he was.

a spectral zone 1.2.speaker: Ghost of Banquo
a spectral zone 1.2.dialogue: Although, I must ask, Macduff. Fleance. Does my son live?

a spectral zone 1.2.speaker: Macduff
a spectral zone 1.2.dialogue: The last I saw of him, he was leaving the sector, where Macbeth will be unable to reach him...

a spectral zone 1.2.speaker: Ghost of Banquo
a spectral zone 1.2.dialogue: ...Ahh. I am contempt. Yet I shall not allow you to charge towards your deaths without a warning

a spectral zone 1.2.speaker: Ghost of Banquo
a spectral zone 1.2.dialogue: Strike me down, prove your worth, and I shall let you pass

a spectral zone 1.3.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.3.dialogue: The spectral zone begins to fade as Macduff deals the final blow against Banquo, finally allowing his soul to rest...

a spectral zone 1.3.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.3.dialogue: ...Only to be met with a new threat. three figures running around in a circle cackling uncontrollingly

a spectral zone 1.3.speaker: Antonia
a spectral zone 1.3.dialogue: And what does that MEAN, Macduff

a spectral zone 1.3.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.3.dialogue: The Monster slowly begins to curl their hand into a fist

a spectral zone 1.3.speaker: Macduff
a spectral zone 1.3.dialogue: 'People' who are usually seen in the dead of night. They are said to be spawns of the devil...

a spectral zone 1.3.speaker: Racheal
a spectral zone 1.3.dialogue: Well, to the best of my knowledge, does seem like assumptions and rumors... I'll go and see if they can help...

a spectral zone 1.3.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.3.dialogue: Before any of us could react, one had suck up to Racheal and drove a knife into her neck as she fell to the ground

a spectral zone 1.3.speaker: Narration
a spectral zone 1.3.dialogue: They attempted to drag her dead body with them, but Snowball had intercepted them, hitting them away with the back of their hand

a spectral zone 1.3.speaker: Macduff
a spectral zone 1.3.dialogue: Do you see what I mean by creatures now

a spectral zone 1.3.speaker: The Monster
a spectral zone 1.3.dialogue: ...They kill without reason, they dancing within the night. There is no mistake about it. These three are men that have become creatures

a spectral zone 1.3.speaker: Goole
a spectral zone 1.3.dialogue: Another one is approaching, be on you guard

Warzone1.speaker: Narration
Warzone1.dialogue: We finally kill the last witch as the spectral zone fully clears

Warzone1.speaker: Tia
Warzone1.dialogue: Ohh, thank goodness. I believe that was the last one. where are we now

Warzone1.speaker: Guillevien Solider
Warzone1.dialogue: To your right, Macduff's enemy group

Warzone1.speaker: Elite Pyro
Warzone1.dialogue: The traitor and the false hammer are here before us

Warzone1.speaker: Narration
Warzone1.dialogue: It did not take long for us to realise that we were in the middle of a war between the pyros and the guillevien knights

Warzone1.speaker: Narration
Warzone1.dialogue: And due to Macduff's title of traitor and The Monster's actions, both sides saw us as an enemy to them...

Warzone1.speaker: Guillevien Commander Ross
Warzone1.dialogue: Ahh, there you are, you fiend. As a result of your actions against us, you shall be sentenced to death by the blade

Warzone1.speaker: The Monster
Warzone1.dialogue: I don't bow down to anyone.

Warzone1.speaker: Guillevien Commander Malcolm
Warzone1.dialogue: MACDUFF! i've been looking everywhere for you so that we can settle this dispute. Where have you been

Warzone1.speaker: Macduff
Warzone1.dialogue: You have certainly gotten much stronger than before, when you asked me to fight with you at first. We shall discuss this after we've chased away the enemy

Warzone1.speaker: Guillevien Solider
Warzone1.dialogue: You truly believe you are above consequence, are you Macduff. We shalln't die until you or that monster are struck down.

Warzone1.speaker: Macduff
Warzone1.dialogue: I accept this fate, strike me down, so I can repent for my actions.

Warzone1.speaker: Guillevien Commander Ross
Warzone1.dialogue: You are not to blame for this. That thing is.

Warzone1.speaker: The Monster
Warzone1.dialogue: The next time i am called a this or creature, I will break your bones, small human

Warzone1.speaker: Guillevien Commander Ross
Warzone1.dialogue: Try me, creature. I've killed monsters more threatening anyways

Warzone1.speaker: Narration
Warzone1.dialogue: This 'Ross' doesn't seem to know when to keep his mouth shut

Warzone1.speaker: Guillevien Commander Malcolm
Warzone1.dialogue: Might I ask you keep your prejudice to youself for now, Ross. We are trying to resolve this. Besides, we have a common enemy

Warzone1.speaker: Kyla
Warzone1.dialogue: I'm in agreement. Banquo mentioned something about Macbeth's castle, and with his current condition, that's the most likely place the spectral core is

Warzone1.speaker: Guillevien Commander Ross
Warzone1.dialogue: That doesn't mean anything if they're traitors. Guards!

Warzone1.speaker: Narration
Warzone1.dialogue: Several Guillevien soldiers began to approach, along with some pyros

Warzone1.speaker: Narration
Warzone1.dialogue: Battle seems to be inevitable in this sector...

Warzone2.speaker: Macduff
Warzone2.dialogue: We've knocked out most of your army, Ross. Now what

Warzone2.speaker: Guillevien Commander Ross
Warzone2.dialogue: You really are powerful, aren't you. I have only one stipulation for you helping us then

Warzone2.speaker: Guillevien Commander Ross
Warzone2.dialogue: Your group must defeat me in a fair duel, then i shall recognise you as equals

Warzone2.speaker: Macduff
Warzone2.dialogue: Ross... We have done this several times before. What makes you think this time will be different

Warzone2.speaker: Guillevien Commander Ross
Warzone2.dialogue: You and your group are not the only ones who can get stronger, and I still wish to bring justice to our comrades killed by 'It'

Warzone2.speaker: The Monster
Warzone2.dialogue: ...Actually, I'd love to spend sometime breaking this fools bones

Warzone2.speaker: Guillevien Commander Malcolm
Warzone2.dialogue: ...If it's fine by you, I'd also wish to fight.

Warzone2.speaker: Guillevien Commander Malcolm
Warzone2.dialogue: If I wish to have the support of the other Thanes in the future, I need to show my strength in this battle against you, Macduff

Warzone2.speaker: Macduff
Warzone2.dialogue: Alright, but just know to fall back if you get hurt to much

Warzone2.speaker: Narration
Warzone2.dialogue: Okay, so I guess this is happening. Well, if it's the only way to prove our worth...

Approach the castle.speaker: Guillevien Commander Ross
Approach the castle.dialogue: *huf* *huf*, such brilliant technique. you teamwork is immaculate

Approach the castle.speaker: Guillevien Commander Malcolm
Approach the castle.dialogue: I believe we are the losers in this battle, so your grudges should be sqwached

Approach the castle.speaker: Narration
Approach the castle.dialogue: Ross went silent for a bit before responding

Approach the castle.speaker: Guillevien Commander Ross
Approach the castle.dialogue: Valient beast, what is your name

Approach the castle.speaker: Narration
Approach the castle.dialogue: ...Actually, I don't even remember asking him for his really name. It can't just be 'Monster' can it?

Approach the castle.speaker: The Monster
Approach the castle.dialogue: Why do you wish to know?

Approach the castle.speaker: Guillevien Commander Ross
Approach the castle.dialogue: I wish to know the names of all who best me in battle, It's how I got to know Macduff as well as i do

Approach the castle.speaker: The Monster
Approach the castle.dialogue: ...I believe we have somewhere to be as of now, miss Kyla

Approach the castle.speaker: Kyla
Approach the castle.dialogue: Understandable. We should bepreparing to enter the castle

Approach the castle.speaker: Narration
Approach the castle.dialogue: The conversation about the Monster's name ended there as we all began to approach the gates.

Approach the castle.speaker: Narration
Approach the castle.dialogue: Suddenly, Ross and Malcolm were intercepted by an elite pyro

Approach the castle.speaker: Guillevien Commander Ross
Approach the castle.dialogue: Move on without us. Figures of this composure should pose us much of a threat

Approach the castle.speaker: Guillevien Commander Malcolm
Approach the castle.dialogue: I request only one thing once you've entered, Macduff...

Approach the castle.speaker: Guillevien Commander Malcolm
Approach the castle.dialogue: ...Treson of such level's punishment goes beyond death. Bring back his head, so that we may make an example of the fool for days to come

Approach the castle.speaker: Narration
Approach the castle.dialogue: Macduff nodded solemnly as we began to fight our way past the remaining pyros blocking our path

Deformalities 1.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 1.dialogue: We had finally pushed our way into the castle, taking down the last pyros standing guard at the front

Deformalities 1.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 1.dialogue: The place was as one would usually expect a flaming castle to look like, Torches burning bright and lively on the walls, portraits of Macbeth with the words 'The God' or 'The Lone Will' written below them

Deformalities 1.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 1.dialogue: However, an odd looking D shaped logo layed as the door ahead of us, a bit of a tonal whiplash compared to everything else here.

Deformalities 1.speaker: Jasmine
Deformalities 1.dialogue: Kyla, Do you know anything about that purple D shaped logo ahead of us

Deformalities 1.speaker: Kyla
Deformalities 1.dialogue: ...Yes. It is the logo of Divinus Congoint. This specific logo is the logo of their Deformality Maintenance Team

Deformalities 1.speaker: Jasmine
Deformalities 1.dialogue: Deformality Maintainance? What are Deformalities anyways

Deformalities 1.speaker: Goole
Deformalities 1.dialogue: ...You know, miss Jasmine, sometimes I find it hard to believe you even lived here in this carter to begin with.

Deformalities 1.speaker: Jasmine
Deformalities 1.dialogue: What's that suppose to mean?

Deformalities 1.speaker: Romeo
Deformalities 1.dialogue: He means it's nearly impossible to find someone who hasn't heard of a Deformality in some way, shape, or form.

Deformalities 1.speaker: Kyla
Deformalities 1.dialogue: ...well, yes. That is very true, Romeo. But to put it simply...

Deformalities 1.speaker: Kyla
Deformalities 1.dialogue: Deformalities are creatures born from someones creative will interacting with a substance called Shados. A bit of Shados also exists in humans and can be drawn out of them to make them into Deformalities or other thing, but the most common place Shados is found is at the very edges of the Crater, or in the Sand Sector, where Shados wells are more commonly found

Deformalities 1.speaker: George
Deformalities 1.dialogue: As a matter of fact, I've seen my fair share of wells in my in S Sector, mainly when taking on jobs paid for by Divinus themselves. They seem to Really want their hands on that stuff for some odd reason

Deformalities 1.speaker: Kyla
Deformalities 1.dialogue: Due to us being on the opposing force against Divinus, That is about where my knowledge on Deformalities ends. However, we may be able to learn a bit more about them the further we travel through this palace

Deformalities 1.speaker: Antonia
Deformalities 1.dialogue: ...judging by the sounds I can hear from behind that door, I think we'll find a lot more than just 'info' here...

Deformalities 1.speaker: Sherlock
Deformalities 1.dialogue: And I thought you only came here for the money. Since when were you so helpful

Deformalities 1.speaker: Antonia
Deformalities 1.dialogue: Since when were you and Goole so talkative.

Deformalities 1.speaker: Sherlock
Deformalities 1.dialogue: I care not what you trying to glean from this response. I only choose to intergect when I see fit.

Deformalities 1.speaker: Antonia
Deformalities 1.dialogue: Okay, smartass. My fault for asking a simple question

Deformalities 1.speaker: Snowball
Deformalities 1.dialogue: Alright, settle down you two. Kyla has been gesturing to something for a while now

Deformalities 1.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 1.dialogue: I look towards Kyla, who seems to be pointing to a display pad on the wall.

Deformalities 1.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 1.dialogue: The Monster gets there first and reads what is visible on the screen

Deformalities 1.speaker: The Monster
Deformalities 1.dialogue: 'Status of Deformality containment in F Sector Branch 1: Coal Giant - BREACHED, Infernal Dragon - BREACHED, Pyro Lord - BREACHED. Clean-up squad alert - PAUSED'

Deformalities 1.speaker: The Monster
Deformalities 1.dialogue: My guess is that Macbeth breached the Deformalities in the facility within his castle to block the armies path, but why would they have a facility in here

Deformalities 1.speaker: Kyla
Deformalities 1.dialogue: ...It is possible that Macbeth and Divinus, like the other Harbinger's, made a deal with eachother, and this facility is a part of that deal.

Deformalities 1.speaker: Jasmine
Deformalities 1.dialogue: Harbingers?

Deformalities 1.speaker: Linda
Deformalities 1.dialogue: Jeez, you know nothing, do you?

Deformalities 1.speaker: Kyla
Deformalities 1.dialogue: ...I will fill you in on the basics later... we must continue forth. The Spectral Core has to be here somewhere, but we will start with Macbeth first

Deformalities 1.speaker: Narration
Deformalities 1.dialogue: Despite me not knowing much about anything in this world, we just continue on, The Monster punching down the door infront of us as we face the Deformalities

Last Deformality 1.speaker: Jasmine
Last Deformality 1.dialogue: Okay, that's the second one down. The last one should be close ahead

Last Deformality 1.speaker: Narration
Last Deformality 1.dialogue: Antonia addressed George directly, who was holding his hammer in hand ready to fight.

Last Deformality 1.speaker: Antonia
Last Deformality 1.dialogue: I have a question... You seemed to have a reaction to the title Sand Hammer, and you also got jobs from Divinus Congoint, which only high quality combatants get. Why is that?

Last Deformality 1.speaker: Narration
Last Deformality 1.dialogue: George though for a bit, looking directly at Antonia before saying

Last Deformality 1.speaker: George
Last Deformality 1.dialogue: Lets just say that I was a man of very high importance... but one who choose to leave that life of importance behind for personal reasons

Last Deformality 1.speaker: Antonia
Last Deformality 1.dialogue: ...well I guess that that's a satisfying enough answer.

Last Deformality 1.speaker: The Monster
Last Deformality 1.dialogue: I see the last one. It seems tuff. Prepare yourselves

The Throne Room.speaker: Narration
The Throne Room.dialogue: We strike down the last Deformality as our fight with it lead us to a huge door adorned with markings of flames and burning figures

The Throne Room.speaker: Jasmine
The Throne Room.dialogue: ...I think we're here

The Throne Room.speaker: Kyla
The Throne Room.dialogue: This is the Throne Room, there's no doubt about it

The Throne Room.speaker: Macduff
The Throne Room.dialogue: May I have the floor to speak...

The Throne Room.speaker: Narration
The Throne Room.dialogue: We all silently wait for Macduff to say anything

The Throne Room.speaker: Macduff
The Throne Room.dialogue: Thank you, now, I would like you all to know somethings

The Throne Room.speaker: Macduff
The Throne Room.dialogue: Duncan, the old king, and a good friend of mine and the rest of the thanes, had this room specially created incase a fight broke out.

The Throne Room.speaker: Macduff
The Throne Room.dialogue: There is a set of traps beneath us that can skewer us every which way, burn us alive, or drop us into pits where no one will here our screams

The Throne Room.speaker: Macduff
The Throne Room.dialogue: Most of this is tied to his throne, so I'll put it simply. The fact that he didn't immediately come straight for us after... Lenuff left is probably because he is currently asleep.

The Throne Room.speaker: Macduff
The Throne Room.dialogue: Our goal should be a quick victory. If he is allowed to awaken, there will only be one way out... Through him.

The Throne Room.speaker: The Monster
The Throne Room.dialogue: That should be simple enough. Besides, we haven't seen Lenuff anywhere in here, so he's probably on the battlefield defending the castle

The Throne Room.speaker: The Monster
The Throne Room.dialogue: Alright, stand back

The Throne Room.speaker: Narration
The Throne Room.dialogue: The monster punched the door down as we all rushed in towards the throne

The Throne Room.speaker: Macbeth
The Throne Room.dialogue: ...Greetings...

The Throne Room.speaker: Narration
The Throne Room.dialogue: Layer upon layers of flames filled the halls behind as we figured that Macbeth was, infact, not asleep, and had currently trapped us in with him and Lenuff, who stood smiling beside his throne

The Throne Room.speaker: Macduff
The Throne Room.dialogue: But how. Lenuff had reached the throne room and told you I was here. Why didn't you hunt me down like you did with my family

The Throne Room.speaker: Macbeth
The Throne Room.dialogue: Oh, simple minded Macduff, that's because I knew, deep down, that you would come to me in the end. Your honour would allow the death of your wife to go unpunished.

The Throne Room.speaker: Macbeth
The Throne Room.dialogue: Lenuff! Seize them and throw them into the flaming pits!

The Throne Room.speaker: Macbeth
The Throne Room.dialogue: What's the matter, Macduff. I thought you were going to cut my head from my shoulders and bring it back to that fool Malcolm

The Throne Room.speaker: Narration
The Throne Room.dialogue: As Lenuff begins to approach slowly, I notice that Macbeth was holding the spectral core within his hands as it pulse a soft, purple glow

The Throne Room.speaker: Narration
The Throne Room.dialogue: Suddenly, my eyes move back to Macduff as he is kicked to the ground by Lenuff

The Throne Room.speaker: Lenuff
The Throne Room.dialogue: Macduff, traitor of the Fire Sector, enemy to thr Pyric Fleat, deserter of all honour, I hearby sentence you to death by cremation for the crimes you've commited

The Throne Room.speaker: Macduff
The Throne Room.dialogue: ...Even now, your memory of me still fades you, child?..

The Throne Room.speaker: Narration
The Throne Room.dialogue: Macduff doesn't even attampt to put up a fight as he is dragged by his face towards the flames behind us.

The Throne Room.speaker: Macbeth
The Throne Room.dialogue: So that's how you end... I gues your Desire to kill wasn't enought to strike down your own son, was it

The Throne Room.speaker: Narration
The Throne Room.dialogue: Suddenly, The monster proceeded to swat Lenuff away and pick up Macduff by the back of his head with one hand

The Throne Room.speaker: The Monster
The Throne Room.dialogue: ...What do you think your doing?

The Throne Room.speaker: Macduff
The Throne Room.dialogue: ...Let me end in peace, monster. There is nothing I can do to sto...

The Throne Room.speaker: The Monster
The Throne Room.dialogue: SHUT UP!!!

The Throne Room.speaker: Narration
The Throne Room.dialogue: Macduff quickly fell silent

The Throne Room.speaker: The Monster
The Throne Room.dialogue: Boohoo, you have no one left, that doesn't mean your only choice is to die with your depression.

The Throne Room.speaker: The Monster
The Throne Room.dialogue: There is an infinite amount of possibilities in this damn carter, so get up and fight or I'll do it my self. Sorry ass...

The Throne Room.speaker: Macduff
The Throne Room.dialogue: Okay, okay... what's the point anyways

The Throne Room.speaker: Lenuff
The Throne Room.dialogue: What do you think your doing?

The Throne Room.speaker: The Monster
The Throne Room.dialogue: Saving one of my allies, what else?

The Throne Room.speaker: Lenuff
The Throne Room.dialogue: Do you think I'll let my mother's killer go without punishment? Never! Now, step out of my way.

The Throne Room.speaker: Macduff
The Throne Room.dialogue: ...Mother's....killer...

The Throne Room.speaker: Narration
The Throne Room.dialogue: Tension began to build in the room

The Throne Room.speaker: Macduff
The Throne Room.dialogue: SO THAT IS HOW YOU LIED TO HIM, YOU TYRANT!?!?!

The Throne Room.speaker: Macbeth
The Throne Room.dialogue: Every pyro must obey me fully. Those words, whether they are true or not, will be true to him forever, Macduff.

The Throne Room.speaker: Macduff
The Throne Room.dialogue: You... You sycopath. YOU MURDERER!!!

The Throne Room.speaker: The Monster
The Throne Room.dialogue: There we go. That's the spirit

The Throne Room.speaker: Macbeth
The Throne Room.dialogue: Lenuff! please make quick work of our uninvited guests, and make it swift.

The Throne Room.speaker: Lenuff
The Throne Room.dialogue: it shall be done, my Lord.

The Throne Room.speaker: Macduff
The Throne Room.dialogue: Forgive me child, I will not hurt you unrepairably, but I need you to stay down for a bit.

Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.speaker: Narration
Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.dialogue: With Lenuff knocked out, we stand before the Tyrant, Macbeth

Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.speaker: Macbeth
Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.dialogue: Ahh, well, I suppose you can't have somethings done by subordinates

Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.speaker: Narration
Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.dialogue: Macbeth tossed the Spectral Core aside as he raised his hand to his side

Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.speaker: Narration
Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.dialogue: Flames circle round the area he put his hand out to as a blazing sword with the a crown and a sun adorned on it's hilt appeared in his hand

Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.speaker: Narration
Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.dialogue: Macbeth then calmly flew out of his throne and stood on the ground infront of all of us, the 12 getting their weapons ready for combat as he looked at his sword

Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.speaker: Macbeth
Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.dialogue: It has been a while since I myself have been forced to fight an intruder, and the time I did... the God Child was the one I fought.

Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.speaker: Macduff
Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.dialogue: I could care less who you've fought. Right now, you are fighting us, and particularly me

Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.speaker: Macbeth
Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.dialogue: You know nothing, Macduff. For I, Macbeth, cannot be defeated by any man born of woman.

Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.speaker: Macduff
Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.dialogue: Then you will be glad to know that I, Macduff was born untimely, ripped from my mother's womb early.

Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.speaker: Macduff
Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.dialogue: What's the matter? Don't get cold feet now.

Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.speaker: Macbeth
Before The Tyrant - Decisive Battle.dialogue: ...Those damn witches played me for the fool I was, yet you think that scares me. I am still MACBETH, the 1ST HARBINGER. SO WHAT IF YOU ARE NOT WOMAN BORN, YOUR POWER IS NOTHING COMPARED TO MINE

Onward1.speaker: Macbeth
Onward1.dialogue: ...But how. My power, you shouldn't compare to me, you weaklings

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: Macduff kicked his mouth closed as he fell to the ground, bleeding

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: Macduff picked up Macbeth by the head, sword ready to cleave his head clean off.

Onward1.speaker: Macduff
Onward1.dialogue: This is for Malcolm and Ross. Ross would have wished he could've done this himself...

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: Macduff's blade was swung...

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: ...Only to clash with another blade...

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: But that other blade was not Macbeth's

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: A mysterious figure, one hand holding a katana like blade, the other holding a gun, blocked Macduff's swing and knocked Macbeth out of his hands

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: Those were Macduff's last words before the figure cut them to shreds
Do I know any of you

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: Everyone, who was already exhausted from the ardruous battle agains Macbeth, got ready to fight again

Onward1.speaker: Macbeth
Onward1.dialogue: ...The God Child! It's him. The God Child!
Rule Number 2 of the Crater: Thou shall not kill one of the 12 Harbingers without adequate permision

Onward1.speaker: Kyla
Onward1.dialogue: ...Shit. Jasmine, stand back. You aren't involved in this

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: I'm pushed back by Kyla as, moving so fast that I physically can't see him, the mysterious figure either slit the throats or cut off the heads of every one of the rest of the 12.
...I don't seem to remember you in our database, so I shall give you a swift introduction...
Welcome to the Crater. Do not test the rules of Divinus, or face divine punishment

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: The man then began to walk towards Macbeth before saying
However, as the victor, I'll respect your honour and finish the job for you

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: Before Macbeth could form a response, or even attempt to fight back, the figure had cut him down as he turn into a red flame shaped crystal

Onward1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward1.dialogue: What did you do to him?
I sealed him within this crystal. Such is the power of Glayd Steel weapons.

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: Suddenly, the figure disappeared in a blitz, crystal in hand.

Onward1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward1.dialogue: H-hey, were did you...

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: I had fallen to my knees, their pure presence enough to scare me from moving.

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: Breathing shakely, I pull out the World Key from my pocket and strike it into the ground to bring them back, only to instantly regret the action

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: Pain so unbearable seizes my entire being as I almost immediately pass out

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: ...I awake in a cold sweat with Kyla beside me as we're outside the castle with the jet we used to get here from Sector N... or whatever it was called.

Onward1.speaker: Kyla
Onward1.dialogue: ...Ahh she's awake...

Onward1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward1.dialogue: Where did he go?

Onward1.speaker: Kyla
Onward1.dialogue: That was Gabriel, the judge of Divinus, and the enforcer of their rules. We had just broken one they had altered on a whim, and had not told anyone about.

Onward1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward1.dialogue: THEY CAN JUST DO THAT!?!?!?

Onward1.speaker: Stan
Onward1.dialogue: Yes, quite unfortunately, but that wasn't why he was here...

Onward1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.dialogue: Stan, who had said that he would only step in if he was truly needed, was standing next to the jet, which was heavily damaged

Onward1.speaker: Macduff
Onward1.dialogue: ...After we were revived and you passed out, we were still stuck there as Macbeth's Hands, what was used to activate the trap, along with the rest of his body, was completely missing. all that was left in there was the spectral core...

Onward1.speaker: Goole
Onward1.dialogue: Then, while we were thinking of ways to get out of the Throne Room, Stan punched straight through the wall next to the throne.

Onward1.speaker: Antonia
Onward1.dialogue: ...Speaking of which, what took you so long to get there. Your way faster than the time you got to us

Onward1.speaker: Stan
Onward1.dialogue: Gabriel was sent here to sabotage our mission by destroying our ship and stranding us here, and he almost succeded with that plan

Onward1.speaker: Stan
Onward1.dialogue: I was able to fight him off the best I could, but he got a lot of decent hit's on the ship...

Onward1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward1.dialogue: So, what your saying is...

Onward1.speaker: Stan
Onward1.dialogue: For the time being, we're stuck here

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...You can't be serious...

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: While we were able to secure the first Spectral core, an agent from Divinus came to stop us

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: Apparently, It was against the rules to eliminate one of the 12 harbingers, so they came to kill us, something we had no counter to

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...he left after wrecking our ride home. But personally, I'm not so sure.

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...So you're saying that...

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...We're stuck here for the forseeable future...

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Stan
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...Yes.

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...and we're not sure if he isn't still watching us right now...

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Stan
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...Possibly...

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: GREAT! Just great!

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Kyla
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: If I were to have a quick input, we should probably reunite with the Guillevien Knights and figure something out from there

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...I've been so paranoid about what this 'Gabriel' person had done that I failed to realise that the Guilevien Knights are still out there fighting right now.

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...You know what, yeah. We should go check out what's going on with them. Better than staying here, I guess...
Not so fast!

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: We look back to see a large group of unrecognised fighters.

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: They wore black samurai robes with dark peach highlights, and they had sheathed katana like swords on their waists

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Commander Drav
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: State your purpose here as a group. We had expected to only find The Thunder Chaneller here

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: I'll give you one better. Who are you guys and why are you even here

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Stan
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: These men seem to be members of the Way Of The Blade, particularly members of the path of wounding, who specialize in causing their opponents to bleed out

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Stan
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...However, they shouldn't be normally here in F Sector at all...

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Commander Drav
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: We have been given a permit to eliminate Macbeth, the 1st Harbinger and the Flame Lord

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: So these are the people who were actually allowed to kill Macbeth.

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Romeo
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...well

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Macduff
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: Macbeth is dead. We did not kill him, however, but we came very close to doing so

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Commander Drav
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...So you're telling me...

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Commander Drav
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...that Macbeth, the tyrant plaguing this land, has been killed by a mysterious person, and his crystal is gone as well?

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Macduff
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...that's about right...

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: The samurai behind the commander began to get a bit rowdy, as it seemed that they had all prepared to fight and were dissapointed that they didn't get to do so

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Commander Drav
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...welp. No fussing over split milk, I guess

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Snowball
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...does that mean that we can leave

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: The man raised his hand, as the group encircled me and the 12, leaving Stan out

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Snowball
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...I'll take that as a no, then.

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Commander Drav
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: Alright men, you all preped and ready?

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Samurai
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: Sir yes sir!

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: H-hey, what are you

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Commander Drav
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: Did you really think we would leave. I'm in a horrid mood today, and fighting that tyrant was my way to cool down. But it seems like I've found a group of small, laughable insects to crush

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: Wow, wow, wow! Lets all calm down for a second!!

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: I look towards Stan, who seems to be making himself comfortable resting while laying on the heavily damaged ship

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: AREN'T YOU GONNA, LIKE, HELP US OR SOMETHING!!!

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Stan
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: Combat assistance isn't part of my deal with Havenus. I'll deal with enemies to Havenus in general, not enemies for this small group.

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: I stand in shock, staring at him as he watches from afar

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...You know what, it's fine, We've got this

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Kyla
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: I'd suggest against excalating this conflict. Killing these people will cause us to make enemies with a powerfu...

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Linda
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...Oh, that doesn't matter. Besides, no one will be able to report back to the Shogun if they're all dead.

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Sherlock
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: My gun is loaded. I wait your commands, Miss Jasmine

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Tia
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: Lets try to finish this as quick as possible

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: George
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...These men shouldn't be much of an issue for us to deal with

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Snowball
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: ...haa. It seems like peace dicussions are but a dream now.

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: The Monster
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: I've been waiting to crush more Skulls to bits!

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Macduff
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: We're ready when you are, Commander

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: Commander... I like that.

Branch 1.1 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.1 Opening.dialogue: Alright. Lets do this!

The Extinguishers.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Commander Drav
The Extinguishers.dialogue: ...Shit...

The Extinguishers.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Samurai
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Commander Jack! We have lost a sizable amount of our forces to these fiends. I would suggest returning to N Sector and reporting these fools to the Sho...

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: With a slash barely visible to my eyes, Jack decapated the WOTB Samurai for even suggesting reporting this encounter to whoever their higher-ups were

The Extinguishers.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Commander Drav
The Extinguishers.dialogue: I should report you even suggesting that to the Shogun, useless pieces of shit anyways...

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: He then looks at us, then looks towards his men

The Extinguishers.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Commander Drav
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Men, return. Regroup with me and fall back

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: And just like that, they all began to retreat and back away

The Extinguishers.speaker: Jasmine
The Extinguishers.dialogue: ...That took a decent while, but it should be over now

The Extinguishers.speaker: Stan
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Good work all around, although I personally would have killed them all in about 47 seconds

The Extinguishers.speaker: Jasmine
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Then why didn't you help us out!?!

The Extinguishers.speaker: Stan
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Corporation Rules. I can't intervene with anything that isn't a large threat to the group

The Extinguishers.speaker: Jasmine
The Extinguishers.dialogue: ...you know what, whatever. I'll just heal up the Elite with the key, and we'll pick up from there

The Extinguishers.speaker: Kyla
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Miss Jasmine, I would not suggest...

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Kyla's words fail to reach me in time, and the moment I pull out the World Key.

The Extinguishers.speaker: Gabriel
The Extinguishers.dialogue: So that is how your revival ability functions

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Gabriel had somehow appeared next to me, sword drawn and ready to strike me down

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: The strike was blocked by Stan, who held his staff up to deflect the strike, eminating static electricity from his body

The Extinguishers.speaker: Gabriel
The Extinguishers.dialogue: ...That will be problematic

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: And with that, he essentially bliped away again. Leaving us to our shock.

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: The moment he leaves, I use the World Key and heal up the group before puting it deep within my pocket

The Extinguishers.speaker: Jasmine
The Extinguishers.dialogue: W-what the hell!?!

The Extinguishers.speaker: Kyla
The Extinguishers.dialogue: ...It seems like my calculations were correct. He knew we could revive, and now knows how we can revive to.

The Extinguishers.speaker: Romeo
The Extinguishers.dialogue: ...it is not unsafe to assume that he is still currently watching our actions as we speak... We must tread with cautiousness

The Extinguishers.speaker: Jasmine
The Extinguishers.dialogue: O-okay. Alright. Calm down. No issue at all

The Extinguishers.speaker: Stan
The Extinguishers.dialogue: If I should remind you all, you're next goal was to go to the Guillevien Knights

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: We all look towards Stan, who had strapped his staff to his back again and began to walk in the general direction of the castle gate

The Extinguishers.speaker: Jasmine
The Extinguishers.dialogue: ...yeah. Alright. Lets go guys.

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: After a bit of walking, we are able to get close to the area we left the Guillevien Knights, when a weird, gaseous smell hits out noses

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: I look towards Kyla, who had said that in a grim, almost fearful voice

The Extinguishers.speaker: Kyla
The Extinguishers.dialogue: T-they should be here. It isn't time for the purging yet

The Extinguishers.speaker: Jasmine
The Extinguishers.dialogue: What's she so worried about?

The Extinguishers.speaker: George
The Extinguishers.dialogue: The Extinguishers... A high class syndicate within the Crater, and one of the five Gourge Vindicator Syndicates

The Extinguishers.speaker: Macduff
The Extinguishers.dialogue: For more information, their one and only goal, their reason for doing what they do, is the elimination of every non-human intelligent creature within the Crater. I believe that this should be the Infernal Branch

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Snowball seemed to move a bit slower after hearing those words from Macduff, yet slowly picked up the pass after a short while.

The Extinguishers.speaker: Macduff
The Extinguishers.dialogue: ...Although, Kyla is right. They should be here right now, as they usually do a Purge Calling beforehand

The Extinguishers.speaker: Jasmine
The Extinguishers.dialogue: What's a Purge Calling?

The Extinguishers.speaker: Macduff
The Extinguishers.dialogue: A Purge Calling is started before a Purge begins, where the syndicate calls non-humans to their base in the area to be killed, a way of peacefully purging them. If about 100 of these non-humans are killed, a Purge does not occur, but that number isn't usually reached

The Extinguishers.speaker: Romeo
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Shocker! Real hard to get someone to lay their life down for the sake of others...

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Eventually, we reach the front of the gate, where several Guillevien Knights and Pyros laid on the ground, with the pyros slowly dissepating from the gas

The Extinguishers.speaker: Macduff
The Extinguishers.dialogue: ...What the hell happened here.

The Extinguishers.speaker: Battered Guillevien Knight
The Extinguishers.dialogue: M-MACDUFF

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: One of the knights had crawled their way over to us, heavily injured and bleeding out

The Extinguishers.speaker: Macduff
The Extinguishers.dialogue: What is the issue!

The Extinguishers.speaker: Battered Guillevien Knight
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Masked inturders, Macduff. They came here saying they planned to kill Macbeth. y-young Malcolm is in danger. Ross is with him as well.

The Extinguishers.speaker: Extinguishing Pyro
The Extinguishers.dialogue: NO! PLEASE!

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: A voice was heard from afar, followed by a swift stomp that crushed whatever was left of the pyro to dust

The Extinguishers.speaker: Youth Class Extinguisher
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Fool. And to think that Macbeth had been eliminated before these creatures.

The Extinguishers.speaker: Kyla
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Miss Jasmine, I STRONGLY suggest we do not...

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: The monster silenced Kyla by covering her mouth before, after making sure she stopped talking, running over to the Extinguisher

The Extinguishers.speaker: Youth Class Extinguisher
The Extinguishers.dialogue: A Beast!?! WHat the hell is an earth monster doing around her...

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Their words were cut short by The Monster who, in one swift, unrelenting motion, punched the Extinguisher's head clean off.

The Extinguishers.speaker: Youth Class Extinguisher
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Brother, are you alright over there.

The Extinguishers.speaker: Narration
The Extinguishers.dialogue: Several Extinguisher's began to approach from within the smoke slowly as the rest had prepared to fight

The Extinguishers.speaker: Kyla
The Extinguishers.dialogue: W-what are you doing!?!

The Extinguishers.speaker: The Monster
The Extinguishers.dialogue: What am I doing. Taking revenge. They harmed the Guillevien Knight's as well, that makes them our enemy

The Extinguishers.speaker: Kyla
The Extinguishers.dialogue: You have no conceivable idea of the enemies you have made, do you!?!

The Extinguishers.speaker: Youth Class Extinguisher
The Extinguishers.dialogue: HEY! OVER THERE! IT'S A GROUP!

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Jasmine
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: There's so many of them... wait! Look ahead! Over there!

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Narration
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Me and the rest of the Elite look over to see a man holding up Ross with a singular hand, with Malcolm on the ground next to him
Interesting. Looks like you aren't under the effect of the toxins at all

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Guillevien Commander Ross
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: ...Got to hell, you bastard!

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Narration
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Kyla began to slowly shuffle behind me and the rest of the elite as the monster began to speak

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: The Monster
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Unhand him...

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Narration
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: The Monster, who had just recently seemed to show a strong sense of distaste for Ross moments prior, had been the first to challenge the figure before us

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Macduff
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Remove thine hands from Ross. He is not your enemy.
Hmm...

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Narration
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: The figure then dropped Ross to the ground and made it's way towards The Monster

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Narration
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: For how towering The Monster was as a figure, The Figure matched his size, towering over the rest of the group.

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Narration
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: He then looked down towards us, eying us down, before staring Kyla down specifically

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Arnold
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Would you look at that. So that's were you ran off too

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Narration
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: As I look toward Kyla in confussion, a shiver begins to run down my spine, as my hand begins to shake uncontrollable

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Arnold
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: What's wrong, little one? Your look shaken up as well. Ohh, I get it. The fear toxins are beginning to kick in, aren't they.

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Narration
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: I back away, swiftly, with the rest of the elite following after me... except for the Monster, who still stood his ground

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Arnold
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Ohh, would you look at that. We got a brave boy here now, do we.

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: The Monster
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Go ahead and try me. Se how brave I really am.

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Narration
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: The Monster cracked his knuckles as Stan, who walked slower than us, finally caught up with our group.

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Jasmine
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Ohh, amazing timing. Stan, this guy seems tuff. You can deal with h...

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Stan
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Girl, that seems like a you problem.

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Kyla
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Miss Jasmine, I'd suggest we evacuate somewhere else and wait this out now that they're not focused on the knights

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Macduff
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Like hell I'm stopping now. They have wronged a group affiliated with us, we must retaliate

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Arnold
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Are you sure about that, stick weilder

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Narration
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Arnold was right behind me, having knocked The Monster away towards a group of dead Guillevien Knights

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Narration
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Before I could react, They attempted to swing at me, but George blocked the swing and kicked the man. The kick barely moved him however.

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Arnold
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Ohh, your a feisty bunch, aren't you. Men! Over here!

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Narration
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: The last of the Extinguisher's then approached us, as the Monster approached the group

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: The Monster
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: I... will not... go down... without a fight...

Arnold Extinguisher.speaker: Jasmine
Arnold Extinguisher.dialogue: Everyone! Attack!! Now!!!

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: We were able to take down the rest of the weaker Extinguisher and hold our own against this Arnold person until they suddenly began to prepare for something

Blades and Punches.speaker: Jasmine
Blades and Punches.dialogue: Everyone! Stay on your guard! We don't know what he could possibly...

Blades and Punches.speaker: Arnold
Blades and Punches.dialogue: CANNONBALL!!!

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: Arnold then jumped into the air and slammed down at the group, creating a cloud of extinguishing gas that pushes me back and knocks me to the ground

Blades and Punches.speaker: Jasmine
Blades and Punches.dialogue: Gahh!!!

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: I'm able to get back on my feet and begin to approach the cloud to get a better visual on the rest of the Elite

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: Most of the group had been knocked out, except for the Monster, who stood strong till facing Arnold, and Kyla, who was starting to get shakey.

Blades and Punches.speaker: Arnold
Blades and Punches.dialogue: ...Huh.

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: The Monster slowly began walking to Arnold, preparing a fist to swing at him with all of their might

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: However, with a swift low kick, Arnold knocked the Monster to the ground.

Blades and Punches.speaker: Arnold
Blades and Punches.dialogue: For a non-human scum... I respect the determination. I just need you to stay down for a bit...

Blades and Punches.speaker: Arnold
Blades and Punches.dialogue: ...what was the name of that one from before? Ross? He seemed to speak highly of your abilities, yet you are still weak in comparison to me... well, that doesn't mean much when he was so weak, anyways...

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: They then stomped on the Monster's head, knocking him out before looking towards the shaking Kyla

Blades and Punches.speaker: Arnold
Blades and Punches.dialogue: And, as for you. It's been so long since we all last met you

Blades and Punches.speaker: Kyla
Blades and Punches.dialogue: S-Stay away from me... I-I'm warning you...

Blades and Punches.speaker: Arnold
Blades and Punches.dialogue: 'I-I'm warning you'. Ohh, look at you talk. I already know you don't pose a threat to me at all...

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: With a swift rush of speed, Arnold grabbed Kyla with one hand and lifter them of the ground.

Blades and Punches.speaker: Arnold
Blades and Punches.dialogue: Them, on the otherhand...

Blades and Punches.speaker: Arnold
Blades and Punches.dialogue: They were the most savage being I knew, a beast in true form. They struck without care, and had the power to back it up. What was they're name again? Ahh, that's right! Hydi...

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: Kyla swung her greatsword and knocked them away, escaping their grasp and falling to the ground, struggling to get on their feet

Blades and Punches.speaker: Arnold
Blades and Punches.dialogue: ...Ohh, I get it now.

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: Arnold grabbed her again, picking her up

Blades and Punches.speaker: Arnold
Blades and Punches.dialogue: You haven't told your little friends about them, have you? Well, I won't spoil such a great suprise...

Blades and Punches.speaker: Arnold
Blades and Punches.dialogue: ...Instead...

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: Arnold then gripped Kyla's hand tightly

Blades and Punches.speaker: Arnold
Blades and Punches.dialogue: ...Lets show them who you truly are.

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: Arnold had then begun attempting to rip off Kyla's arm, causing a physical reactiong of pain from her

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: In many ways, Arnold tortured her, trying to draw something out of her as I stood helpless to stop him

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: I look towards Stan again, who stood there with his hands in his pocket.

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: I know he's strong. He was able to fight Garbiel of, and had the title of the Thunder Channeler. He could easily take care of this, yet due to some sort of ruling, he couldn't help out against groups that aren't a threat to us

Blades and Punches.speaker: Jasmine
Blades and Punches.dialogue: SURELY YOU SHOULD BE ALLOWED TO STEP IN NOW, RIGHT?

Blades and Punches.speaker: Stan
Blades and Punches.dialogue: Once your life is in any danger... yes.

Blades and Punches.speaker: Jasmine
Blades and Punches.dialogue: But what about her. Surely you can do something about it?

Blades and Punches.speaker: Stan
Blades and Punches.dialogue: It seems like it's about to sort itself out right now.

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: I look towards Arnold, just to see him on one knee and Kyla on the ground. Behind Arnold was Jack, the WOTB commander from earlier, along with the rest ot the WOTB Samurai that left with him.

Blades and Punches.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Commander Drav
Blades and Punches.dialogue: So these were the other people that came here to kill Macbeth. Didn't think the Extinguisher's to be such a confident force of shitheads

Blades and Punches.speaker: Arnold
Blades and Punches.dialogue: ...That was a lucky hit you...

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: The Commander, Jack, then kicked Arnold to the ground causing him to lay face first, making the huge, deep slash mark left from Jack's Balde visible to me

Blades and Punches.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Commander Drav
Blades and Punches.dialogue: Who the hell asked your ass to speak up to a Way Of The Blade Commander? Someone has no regard for their own damn life, huh.

Blades and Punches.speaker: Goole
Blades and Punches.dialogue: ...Jasmine...

Blades and Punches.speaker: Narration
Blades and Punches.dialogue: I look to my left as an exhausted Elite move beside me with a knocked out Kyla near them

Blades and Punches.speaker: Goole
Blades and Punches.dialogue: It would appear that we have to fight the Way Of The Blade again. We are prepared for battle

Blades and Punches.speaker: Jasmine
Blades and Punches.dialogue: Alright. Lets beat them quickly and get out of here

Coals.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Commander Drav
Coals.dialogue: Gahh!!!

Coals.speaker: Narration
Coals.dialogue: With a strike of her spear for the finishing blow, Racheal stabbed Jack through the chest

Coals.speaker: WOTB Path Of Wounding Commander Drav
Coals.dialogue: *cough* *cough* huh... Well, guess this is it, huh. This is where I die... to bastards like yo...

Coals.speaker: Narration
Coals.dialogue: Racheal pulled her spear out of his chest and used it to slash his head off so he could no longer talk

Coals.speaker: Racheal
Coals.dialogue: With that dealt with...

Coals.speaker: Arnold
Coals.dialogue: ...I believe... you all are forgeting someone.

Coals.speaker: Narration
Coals.dialogue: To the shock of everyone, Arnold had somehow gotten back up again, bleeding profussly from his back, and had tried to approach the group.

Coals.speaker: Arnold
Coals.dialogue: ...You... won't... be... GETING AWA...

Coals.speaker: Narration
Coals.dialogue: With a punch to the jaw that rotated his neck, the Monster killed the already exhausted and injured Over-Tinguisher

Coals.speaker: The Monster
Coals.dialogue: That was easy. I believe we need to be somewhere now...
Not, so, fast!

Coals.speaker: Narration
Coals.dialogue: We look in the direction of which the voice came from, only to see an army of figures weilding spears, the one at the center having two swords at his side.

Coals.speaker: Narration
Coals.dialogue: I could notice Racheal bacing away for a bit, but then they walk back to their original position after Stan spoke up

Coals.speaker: Stan
Coals.dialogue: The Coal Army...

Coals.speaker: Jasmine
Coals.dialogue: The Coal Army? Who are these guys?

Coals.speaker: Stan
Coals.dialogue: They are essentially a huge bunch of sentient Coal people except for their leader, who has evolved beyond their natural limit's and claimed the title of the Diamond Commander

Coals.speaker: Jasmine
Coals.dialogue: So, what your saying is...

Coals.speaker: Stan
Coals.dialogue: It would be unwise to get on their bad side.

Coals.speaker: Jasmine
Coals.dialogue: Okay, we can just talk this out peacefully and be on our way... wait, why are they charging down the hill

Coals.speaker: Narration
Coals.dialogue: We all look at the army charging towards us as a shout can be heard again

Coals.speaker: Coal Army Member
Coals.dialogue: You are the guards of Macbeth's gate. We are here to eliminate him, so you must fall as well

Coals.speaker: Jasmine
Coals.dialogue: Well, we're fucked.

Coals.speaker: Narration
Coals.dialogue: The rest of the group prepares to fight as Macduff shouts across the battlefield

Coals.speaker: Macduff
Coals.dialogue: LISTEN. THERE HAS BEEN A MISUNDERSTANDING. MACBETH IS ALREADY DEAD

Coals.speaker: Narration
Coals.dialogue: Another shout is heard as they draw closer

Coals.speaker: Coal Army Member
Coals.dialogue: That's what someone standing guard would want us the think.

Coals.speaker: Vin
Coals.dialogue: Continue to charge forth. Do not attack the Thunder Channeler. He is most likely not a guard, and will not stop you

Coals.speaker: Jasmine
Coals.dialogue: Can you, like, actually do something for once...

Coals.speaker: Stan
Coals.dialogue: You know the answer to that...

Coals.speaker: Jasmine
Coals.dialogue: Alright... Okay... We got this...

Onward1.1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.1.dialogue: It was a massacare.

Onward1.1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.1.dialogue: While we were able to take down some of the coal army, Vin, the Diamond Commander, ripped the team to shreds, killing each of the elite with relative ease

Onward1.1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.1.dialogue: Vin also seemed to give off the same aura that Gabriel did when he appeared both times, that feeling off complete hopelessness...

Onward1.1.speaker: Vin
Onward1.1.dialogue: Hey, you. You're part of this group to, aren't you

Onward1.1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.1.dialogue: ...That feeling of no matter what you do... you couldn't hope to surpass them...

Onward1.1.speaker: Vin
Onward1.1.dialogue: Answer now, or I will be forced to eliminate you.

Onward1.1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward1.1.dialogue: Hey, Stan

Onward1.1.speaker: Stan
Onward1.1.dialogue: What?

Onward1.1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward1.1.dialogue: How strong do you think you are in comparison to this guy?

Onward1.1.speaker: Stan
Onward1.1.dialogue: I'd say we're pretty close in terms of strength.

Onward1.1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward1.1.dialogue: Good... another question...

Onward1.1.speaker: Jasmine
Onward1.1.dialogue: ...Do you trust me?

Onward1.1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.1.dialogue: I reach into my pocket as Vin begins to pull out the Diamond Cutters

Onward1.1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.1.dialogue: Stan pulls this staff out from his back

Onward1.1.speaker: Stan
Onward1.1.dialogue: You don't know how long I've waited for a rematch...

Onward1.1.speaker: Vin
Onward1.1.dialogue: What are you two talking abou...

Onward1.1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.1.dialogue: From my pocket, I pull out the World Key, and, like a moth to a flame, Gabriel seems to blitz towards it

Onward1.1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.1.dialogue: Both Stan and Vin's eyes lock with Garbiel, as he backs away upon seeing Vin

Onward1.1.speaker: Gabriel
Onward1.1.dialogue: ...shit... of all people.

Onward1.1.speaker: Vin
Onward1.1.dialogue: Well, well, well. Been a while, hasn't it been, Gabriel.

Onward1.1.speaker: Gabriel
Onward1.1.dialogue: Can we not do this here, I am on a mission.

Onward1.1.speaker: Vin
Onward1.1.dialogue: A mission, huh. Like your mission to try and assasinate me? Don't make me laugh.

Onward1.1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.1.dialogue: Unexpectedly, these two seemed to have a long history with eachother

Onward1.1.speaker: Vin
Onward1.1.dialogue: You. Leave my sight. If Gabriel is after you, then you are no guard for Macbeth

Onward1.1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.1.dialogue: Using this opportunity, I revive the elite and we group up and back away from the three high power combatants, who look like they are all getting ready to fight

Onward1.1.speaker: Vin
Onward1.1.dialogue: Yo, Stan, you can leave this one to me. He shouldn't be much of a problem

Onward1.1.speaker: Stan
Onward1.1.dialogue: You really think I'd just let him leave? Not a chance!

Onward1.1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.1.dialogue: Electric Sparks flew around the enviroment as Stan's staff became a spear of lightening and his suit a knight's armour made of electricity

Onward1.1.speaker: Vin
Onward1.1.dialogue: Alirght, just don't get in my way

Onward1.1.speaker: Gabriel
Onward1.1.dialogue: You're making a big mistake trying me Vin. I could...

Onward1.1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.1.dialogue: In a blitz, Vin lands a kick to the chest, staggering Gabriel quite a bit.

Onward1.1.speaker: Vin
Onward1.1.dialogue: What was that again? Sorry, I don't think I could hear you well.

Onward1.1.speaker: Narration
Onward1.1.dialogue: Stan and Vin began to fight Gabriel as we watch in awe at the display of strength before us

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: I and the Elite watch as Gabriel alone holds his own against the joint efforts of Stan and Vin, who are both high tier combatants in their own right. The fight is intense, with sparks flying and the ground shaking from their powerful blows.

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: I use the oppurtunity to inform the rest of the Elite of what I plan to do as of now.

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Alright everyone. Who knows the nearest exit to this Sector

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Due to the unlikeliness of Stan being killed in battle, I used pulling out the world key as a way to get Gabriel and Stan to fight, and escape Vin in the commotion. I didn't expect Vin to have a grudge against Gabriel as well, but that means we're off the hook when it comes to him. So we just need to get out of here...

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Racheal
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: The closest place is W Sector. I know the closest way there... but we'd need a vehicle

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Romeo
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: We could use that car over there...

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Romeo spoke up, pointing to a car not far from us

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Sherlock
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: And how exactly do you know if that would work... Heck, why would a car be out here in the opening anyways?

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: It's worth a shot. Besides, I myself am willing to take any method of getting out of here

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Sherlock, slightly annoyed but still also wanting to leave the area, resigned to his thoughts as we approach the large car
THEY'RE COMING HERE, WHAT SHOULD I DO
Just act natural. Don't get aggresive

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Two voices could be heard from the inside of the large car as the window rolled down

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Male Driver
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: ...Hey, how are you all doing. I see you've crowded around this nice vehicle of ours...

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Jasmine
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: We just wanted a lift out of here, that's all

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: The man looked at the group, then looked to a female with a camera in front passenger seat, who nodded at him, then looked to us again

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Male Driver
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Where to?

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Kyla
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Our most favoured location would be W Sector, if that is within your abilities. COuld you also make it as quick as possible?

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Male Driver
