Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: ...Sure, hop on in, there should be enough space for all of you.

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: I was a bit sceptical, as it looked like a preety small vehicle from the outside. But as we entered, it was revealed to be much more spacious on the inside that it was on the outside

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Our group of 13 all fit inside perfectly fine as the back seat doors closed and the car began to drive off.

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Male Driver
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: So, there are 13 of you, and a trip between sectors is 20 Div per person...

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Kyla
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Don't worry about the pricing. Havenus will ensure that you are paid handsomely for your services...

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Female Photographer
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Wait, you guy's are with Havenus?

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: The girl spoke up in an excited high pitched voice in response to what Kyla had said

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Male Driver
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Calm down Emil. You'll weird out our customers.

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Female Photographer
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Sorry, I'm just really excited about meating someone from Havenus. So what the goal of you Branch?

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Kyla
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Well, that would be the finding and destroying of the Spectral Cores that have begun appearing around the crater.

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Female Photographer
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Woah, that's so cool...

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Male Driver
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: At least introduce yourself first, they don't even know who you are

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Emilia
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: My mistake. My name is Emilia, and his is Joel.

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Joel
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: I said introduce yourself, not me!

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Emilia
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Woops, my mistake.

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Narration
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: In proper courtesy, me and the rest of the Elite also introduce ourselves to the duo as we drive between hills of orange grass

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Macduff
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Now that we've introduced ourselves, I have a question. What made you approach the gates of Macbeth Castle. did you also want to try and kill the tyrant

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Emilia
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: No actually. My goal is to take photographs of all the wonders of the crater and bring it back to N Sector. I came here for a picture of the castle...

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Joel
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: And she's paid me to drive her all around the crater to get these pictures, so that's why we were there

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Kyla
Branch 1.2 Opening.dialogue: Interesting. Could I have a look at the pictures you've already collected

Branch 1.2 Opening.speaker: Emilia

Onward1.2.dialogue: Interesting. So your fists control lightening energy in delayed or instant versions, and with such power as well.

Onward1.2.dialogue: I'd suggest we leave her here and catch the next intersector bus. It's our best chance of catching the boats at the port before they leave

Onward1.2.dialogue: Hey, miss Kyla.

Onward1.2.speaker: Kyla
Onward1.2.dialogue: Yeah...

Onward1.2.speaker: Emilia
Onward1.2.dialogue: About the spectral cores you were talking about before, where exactly do you need to go to find them

Onward1.2.speaker: Kyla
Onward1.2.dialogue: Well, actually, from the data given to us, there is a spectral core in every sector...

Onward1.2.speaker: Emilia
Onward1.2.dialogue: Is it possible that we could join you in finding them...

Onward1.2.speaker: Joel
Onward1.2.dialogue: EMILIA!!!

Onward1.2.speaker: Kyla
Onward1.2.dialogue: Well... if you both wish to

Onward1.2.dialogue: Joel thought for a bit, before responding

Onward1.2.speaker: Joel

Onward1.2.speaker: Jasmine
Onward1.2.dialogue: That's great, actually, we could use someone of your skill and prowess in our job. Welcome you two.

Onward1.2.speaker: Joel

Onward1.2.speaker: Emilia
Onward1.2.dialogue: Don't worry, it shoulsn't take to long

My my, mister Gabriel. Looks like you didn't come out of that fight cleanly

Onward1.2.dialogue: I see. I guess even the strongest have their weaknesses...

Onward1.2.speaker: Lenuff
Onward1.2.dialogue: Hey! Gabriel!

Onward1.2.dialogue: Gabriel turned to Lenuff, who was impatiently taping his foot

Onward1.2.speaker: Lenuff
Onward1.2.dialogue: Is there a reason you picked ME up and brought me HERE of all places. You know I don't do well with water like... at all, right?

Onward1.2.speaker: Gabriel
Onward1.2.dialogue: Ohh, quit the fuss, child. We won't be here for long. We're here because we're looking for someone. Specifically, a Aquatic, and one willing to join us

Onward1.2.speaker: Lenuff
Onward1.2.dialogue: I know that... it's just, a bit of fear. You know, when your surrounded by water and your completely made of fire.
Tell me about it

Onward1.2.speaker: Context Narration
Onward1.2.dialogue: A feminine figure with a body of fire, two fiery wings, and the name tag 'Afine' approached the group

Onward1.2.speaker: Afine
Onward1.2.dialogue: Tybalt said that the locals told him that they haven't seen any Aquatics in ages. They said that they'd look dor them if Divinus is the one asking

Onward1.2.speaker: Victor
Onward1.2.dialogue: And about the spectral core? The one that Havenus is currently after, that is.

Onward1.2.speaker: Afine
Onward1.2.dialogue: No unusual readings coming from the sea, so that's a relief. A Sector, which floats above W Sector, has mentioned that they don't know much either, but I wouldn't trust the words of Napoleon that deeply.

Onward1.2.speaker: Gabriel
Onward1.2.dialogue: So were is it then. It has to be somewhere here

Onward1.2.speaker: Context Narration
Onward1.2.dialogue: Gabriel said, rapping a abndage around one of the wounds on his arm that had started bleeding again

Onward1.2.speaker: Afine
Onward1.2.dialogue: Well, we have got a faint reading of life from a small island. people are speculating that that's were the Aquatics are, but some people would beg to differ

Onward1.2.speaker: Tybalt
Onward1.2.dialogue: Well, thanks for telling him everything I was meant to say to him, Afine

Onward1.2.speaker: Afine
Onward1.2.dialogue: Well, you snooze, you lose

Onward1.2.speaker: Tybalt
Onward1.2.dialogue: Anyways, I was unfortunately unable to secure a boat. There were none left when I got there.

Onward1.2.speaker: Gabriel
Onward1.2.dialogue: Haaa. I guess were take the plane then. We're gonna be here for a while, aren't we?

Opening 2.speaker: Narration
Opening 2.dialogue: We've been waiting for a while here now. It's been 40 minutes and not a singular bus has arrived.

Opening 2.speaker: Joel
Opening 2.dialogue: Damn. Where the hell is this damn bus... It's starting to get cold out here

Opening 2.speaker: Racheal
Opening 2.dialogue: The seas are probably going to be colder. If you cannot handle the chilling breeze here, you'll be hopeless out there when surrounded by water...

Opening 2.speaker: Emilia
Opening 2.dialogue: So, while we're here. Did you guys come with anyone else. I did see you talking to that big guy with the staff back in F Sector

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: He is Stan, one of the High Ranked Supressors Havenus Corperation have hired.

Opening 2.speaker: Jasmine
Opening 2.dialogue: Well, now that we have the time. I know now that High ranked supressors are probably enlisted to keep the peace in here... but how does one become a High Ranked Supressor

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: Well, it's a bit simple. You must past the Test of Vigor, and the only way to even take the test is to be a well known supressor in the crater, have a more than 90% success rate in supression jobs taken, and have a quick skill or factor that only the supressor can do.

Opening 2.speaker: Jasmine
Opening 2.dialogue: Interesting. I assume that Vin, fro F Sector, would be considered one due to the two diamond katanas we saw him use alongside his diamond halbeard... but what about Stan

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: Stan is a high ranked supressor because as of now, he is one of the only living people to overcome their own mind.

Opening 2.speaker: Emilia
Opening 2.dialogue: ...And what's that suppose to mean?

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: Do you remember that, at one point, I talked about how shados exists in everyone, and can be drawn out of someone to turn them into Deformalities

Opening 2.speaker: Jasmine
Opening 2.dialogue: ...yeah.

Opening 2.speaker: Narration
Opening 2.dialogue: I continue listening, noticing that Emilia, who was also eager to hear what Kyla had to say, had taken out a notebook and started writing stuff down in it

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: The source of that Shados is derived directly from the mind, bonding with ones emotions.

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: The more emotionally stable a person is, the clearer their mind. However, as one becomes emotionally unstable through any means, their mind begins to fill with thoughts. Thoughts of violence, thoughts of lossing all care for anyone around them, thoughts only benefiting themselves.

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: From this point, one of 3 things can happen. They can accept said thoughts as true, causing the shados within them to slowly overcome them, ignore said thoughts and continue living with an unstable mind, or strongly deny the thoughts that attempt to consume them.

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: Choosing to deny will cause the person to purify the shados within them, causing them to break their limits and accend to a high place of power.

Opening 2.speaker: Narration
Opening 2.dialogue: Thinking back to when we left Vin and Stan to fight Gabriel, I could remember his normal suit and staff turning into a lightening spear and armour.

Opening 2.speaker: Jasmine
Opening 2.dialogue: So Stan's tranformation before we left...

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: Yes, Miss Jasmine. The armour and spear of pure lightening he had was a result of this process, his Limit being broken.

Opening 2.speaker: Joel
Opening 2.dialogue: Well, that's quite interesting.

Opening 2.speaker: Emilia
Opening 2.dialogue: W-woah! Joel! I didn't expect you to be one to try and listen to something like this.

Opening 2.speaker: Joel
Opening 2.dialogue: Well I didn't find the rest of the groups conversations to be of interest... so I came to see what you guys were doing.

Opening 2.speaker: Narration
Opening 2.dialogue: Joel's mention of the rest of the group made me realise... I don't really know any of the elite. Well, I know their general attitudes, but thats about it.

Opening 2.speaker: Narration
Opening 2.dialogue: Well, if we're going to be travelling together for a while, I thought, why not try to get to know them better by listening to their conversations

Opening 2.speaker: Macduff
Opening 2.dialogue: No! I'm not gonna tell you were I left mny F Sector armour before I joined here.

Opening 2.speaker: Antonia
Opening 2.dialogue: But it would sell for a lot. Hell, I'll even split the cash with you if you just tell me

Opening 2.speaker: Macduff
Opening 2.dialogue: You don't seem to understand. That armour and that blade are the only remaining remenants of what was once the great F Sector Army. I'm not just going to sell it of for cash that easily

Opening 2.speaker: Snowball
Opening 2.dialogue: Young beast, is anything on your mind.

Opening 2.speaker: The Monster
Opening 2.dialogue: Why do you want to know.

Opening 2.speaker: Snowball
Opening 2.dialogue: Well, you've been silent for a while since we've been waiting for the bus. You must be thinking about something

Opening 2.speaker: Narration
Opening 2.dialogue: Snowball moves closer to THe Monster, attempting to get him to answer her question.

Opening 2.speaker: The Monster
Opening 2.dialogue: Well... the sea's quite a memorable sight... the way it glistens and shines.

Opening 2.speaker: Snowball
Opening 2.dialogue: ...Well, that makes sense. I've taken a bit of a likening to it ever since i've seen it.

Opening 2.speaker: Goole
Opening 2.dialogue: So, you're part of the Watchers. I honestly expected only one of us to be here.

Opening 2.speaker: Sherlock
Opening 2.dialogue: Well I do work individually from them. I'd consider myself quite skilled at my work

Opening 2.speaker: Narration
Opening 2.dialogue: They both started talking about cases and work for an organisation called The 12 Watchers, but I couldn't be bothered to continue listening after a while

Opening 2.speaker: Romeo
Opening 2.dialogue: Hey! Everyone! Down the road

Opening 2.dialogue: We all look down the road afet Romeo's call to see that a bus had finally made it's way to were we are

Opening 2.speaker: Emilia
Opening 2.dialogue: Finally. I thought we'd be standing here all day.

Opening 2.speaker: Kyla
Opening 2.dialogue: These buses usually go directly to the port, so we'll get a boat from there.

Opening 2.speaker: Narration
Opening 2.dialogue: However, as we all go into the bus, we notice that it was filled to the brim with bandits.

Opening 2.speaker: Joel
Opening 2.dialogue: ...Well, I wouldn't mind waiting for another...

Opening 2.speaker: Narration
Opening 2.dialogue: The door of the bus closes behind us as all of them begin to approach

Opening 2.speaker: Joel
Opening 2.dialogue: Well fuck.

Opening 2.speaker: Jasmine
Opening 2.dialogue: Thieves. Everyone. be on guard

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: We take out the last of the thugs, including the driver, who had tried to join in on the fight.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: After throwing the bodies out of the bus, Joel goes into the drivers seat and analyzes

The Boat.speaker: Macduff
The Boat.dialogue: And what do you want to do.

The Boat.speaker: Joel
The Boat.dialogue: I'm the only one with verifiable experience driving a vehicle, so I'd love to see any of you disagree with me driving

The Boat.dialogue: Alright, to the port we go. This should take a bit, however, so I'd suggest you all try and rest for a while.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Deciding to take their advise, I attempt to close my eyes and take a small nap before we have to get to work again

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Falling to sleep, quite swiftly, I begin to dream about all the stuff we had done before from my memory.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Fighting Malcolm and Ross, defeating Macbeth, fighting the entiguishers and the lady with the fans.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Then, my mind began to recall something I had no prior memory on. A figure in full white armour and sword with a helmet with a four pointed star on it, a man in a white suit with a four pointed star on his forehead, and what looked to be a giant worm-like creature with the same star shape as it's mouth

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Infront of the three of them were three injured fighters, one with a cracked black mask, sword, and armour, on with a steel mask, red eyes, and a huge greatsword, and one with several roots surrounding them like a shield

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Behind them was a tree like structure surrounded by desert.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Suddenly, the scene shifted before my eyes as I see a blade stabbed directly through my heart by a person that seems to be blocked out. The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: Ughh, my head... were are we exactly?

The Boat.speaker: Snowball
The Boat.dialogue: Ohh, Miss Jasmine has awoken!

The Boat.speaker: Romeo
The Boat.dialogue: Took you long enough

The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: What-guhh... happened when I was asleep?

The Boat.speaker: Kyla
The Boat.dialogue: You had a fever at somepoint while you were asleep. Your temperature rose to unsafe levels...

The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: Ughh. Well that would explain why my head is killing me right now.

The Boat.speaker: Kyla
The Boat.dialogue: Do you have an idea on why this would happen at all.

The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: Well, I was think about our time in F ans W Sector, then I-GAHH!!!

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Upon trying to recall the meory, my headache suddenly spiked uncontrollably, causing me to collapse.

The Boat.speaker: Joel
The Boat.dialogue: Hey. Is everything okay back there. You sure we don't need to go to a hospital or something

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: After a bit, I quickly regain my posture, patting my head as the headache slightly passed

The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: N-no. I'm fine... I guess.

The Boat.speaker: Joel
The Boat.dialogue: Alright, but don't blame me if it gets worse. Anyways, we're officially here!

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Looking out the windows, we find ourselves at the main port that can take us to the city on the sea

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: I staggeredly get of the bus with everyone else as I attempt to recuperate from the painful headache I had just seconds ago

The Boat.speaker: Kyla
The Boat.dialogue: Ahh, over there, there's still a boat preped to leave. Let's move over there

The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: Alright... but gimme a sec. My head still hurts like crazy...

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Suddenly, The Monster grabbed me and put me on his shoulder as they walked towards the boat

The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: H-HEY!!!

The Boat.speaker: The Monster
The Boat.dialogue: Considering how unwell you are, it was unlikely you would have made it to the boat walking on your own. So, I saw it fit to carry you there

The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: W-well, i didn't really need the help but... ughh, thanks. When the hell will this headache finally fade

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: We all approach the boat the boat as Kyla is about to speak up, but after they look at the entire group the sailors immediately speak up

The Boat.speaker: Sailor
The Boat.dialogue: No fee rquired. Just hop on, I can tell you're in a hurry

The Boat.dialogue: Well... okay...

The Boat.speaker: Joel
The Boat.dialogue: That's... weird. Even under those conditions, no one does something for free here

The Boat.speaker: Macduff
The Boat.dialogue: We should stay prepared. We haven't but a clue on what they are going to attempt next.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: We enter the living area of the boat, where we are able to rest again.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: I end up geting laid down on a long couch back first so that I can rest and recover, my headache still causing me trouble

The Boat.speaker: Sherlock
The Boat.dialogue: So, what do we do about her. I don't believe anyone has anything to treat her condition, nor do we have anyone with skills as a doctor

The Boat.speaker: Antonia
The Boat.dialogue: We could probably find medicine for her once we reach the city. It'd be a miracle if they didn't have any of the medicine created in G Sector.

The Boat.speaker: George
The Boat.dialogue: That is... IF we can reach the city

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: George gestures towards the door, signifying the idea that the sailors maybe untrustworthy in their practices

The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: I'll be fine. It's really just a simple headache. Nothing to fuss much about...

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Kyla looked to me with a bit of concern as they began to speak

The Boat.speaker: Kyla
The Boat.dialogue: I respect your wishes for us to not worry about you, but if your condition ends up becoming fatal, our mission will be considered a failure...

The Boat.speaker: Romeo
The Boat.dialogue: Heeh... I knew there was a catch. Just had to be.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Romeo looked directly at Kyla before speaking up again

The Boat.speaker: Romeo
The Boat.dialogue: So... who is it?

The Boat.speaker: Kyla
The Boat.dialogue: ...what are you refering to?

The Boat.speaker: Romeo
The Boat.dialogue: You know the answer to that. Who do you intend to bring back? Why does this mission mean so much to you?

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Kyla slowly looked down to their hand as they stood, before looking at Romeo and saying...

The Boat.speaker: Kyla
The Boat.dialogue: I wish to fix a mistake...

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Romeo moved his gaze to me, then the rest of the group, then back at Kyla

The Boat.speaker: Romeo
The Boat.dialogue: I guess that's a sufficient enough answer... whatever...

The Boat.speaker: Sailor
The Boat.dialogue: If you all are done talking, the captain will like to have a talk with all of you

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: All of us look towards the sailor, other Emilia, who was to busy taking pictures of the ocean

The Boat.speaker: Joel
The Boat.dialogue: Emil!

The Boat.speaker: Emilia
The Boat.dialogue: Ohh, sorry... I got a bit carried away there

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: After a short walk, we find our way onto the main deck, with the broad ocean directly in our view as we meet the captain of the ship

The Boat.speaker: Captain
The Boat.dialogue: Ahh, quite the group we have here. And of differing...

The Boat.speaker: Macduff
The Boat.dialogue: What do you want from us.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Taken aback by Macduff's sudden accusation, the Captain thought to himself deeply, before speeking up immediately

The Boat.speaker: Captain
The Boat.dialogue: Well, since you first timers actually have some survival instinct, I'll cut straight to the point

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: The Sailors surrounded us, ores pointed to the group in a circle formation

The Boat.speaker: Captain
The Boat.dialogue: We want his gloves.

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Joel was shocked by the sudden declaration. before immediately denying the offer

The Boat.speaker: Joel
The Boat.dialogue: You can go eat shit if you think I'm giving you these.

The Boat.speaker: Kyla
The Boat.dialogue: Is there any other way we can pay you that isn't his gloves

The Boat.speaker: Captain
The Boat.dialogue: Money is useless for seafarers like us. We already have stacks of it in the bottome deck... although

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: The Captain pondered for a bit before deciding.

The Boat.speaker: Captain
The Boat.dialogue: If you land folk and defeat us in combat, we will respect your side of the bargain, and you will not have to pay us for this trip

The Boat.speaker: Jasmine
The Boat.dialogue: Well-ughh, that should be a better choice. Right guys.

The Boat.speaker: Joel
The Boat.dialogue: Alright, that's a compromise I guess

The Boat.speaker: Narration
The Boat.dialogue: Despite my current condition, I am able to command the elite into battle as the sailors prepare to challenge us

An Attack.speaker: Captain
An Attack.dialogue: Woah, woah. Hold on land dwellers. Looks like someones eager to prove themselves

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: I believe that we should be allowed to stay on this boat without paying now

An Attack.speaker: Captain
An Attack.dialogue: As if. That was some of the most great battling I've ever expericenced. Most people just give up and are surrounded after the first two waves of sailors, but you all got all the way to me. Ohh, and you with the shock gloves. I can tell why you wanted to keep them. Your amazing with them.

An Attack.speaker: Joel
An Attack.dialogue: ...Thanks... I guess...

An Attack.speaker: Captain
An Attack.dialogue: Here have my card. You semed to be the one in charge of this capable bunch

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: The captain hands me a card with the words 'N Sector Boat Service: Platinum Class Consumer'

An Attack.speaker: Captain
An Attack.dialogue: With that, you should be able to get free boats from our N Sector base

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: T-thanks, but... UGhh.

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: My headache suddenly flared without reason as I fall to one knee

An Attack.speaker: Captain
An Attack.dialogue: You okay miss. You sea sick or something

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: No no it's... mmph... just headache. That's all.

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: I believe we should be on our way

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: We mtake our leave from the main deck, heading back down into the living quarter

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: O-okay. I'm starting to think this is probably worse than just a headache

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: I would suggest taking a rest until we get into the city. We should be on this ship for about a day until we reach the city

An Attack.speaker: The Monster
An Attack.dialogue: I think it's best that we all rest on. It's getting dark, and we've basically been fighting for the whole day

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Everyone akes there own space to attempt to go to sleep as I stare to the ceiling with my eyes open

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Closing my eyes slowly, I slowly fall asleep, trying to ignore my painful headache

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: I try to take my mind of what had caused my headache, however, all I could see was a heart at somepoint

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: The heart was beating normally in the rhythm of mine, leaving me to believe that it was my heart

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Then, suddenly, the heart began to beat louder and louder, confussing me deeply as suddenly a dark looking blade stabbed directly through the heart

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Suddenly I awoke and was coughing uncontrollably. After a while, I was able to stop myself, looking around and seeing Kyla, with bags under her eyes, walking towards me

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: M-miss Kyla, are you... alright.

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: I don't think so. Along with the headache, my heart hurts slightly now...

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: I took some time to look towards Kyla and notice she wasn't in the best of conditions either. She had some water on her face, she was VERY visibly tired, and was shaky...

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Kyla, you look horrible! How long have you been awake for

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Kyla turned her head away from me.

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: Don't spend your time worrying about me, Miss Jasmine. What matters now is that you make a swift recovery

An Attack.speaker: Narration

An Attack.dialogue: She looked in the mirror within the room, turning on the tap and splashing water on her face as she muttered to herself

An Attack.speaker: Kyla
An Attack.dialogue: Why won't you just leave me alone. Why won't you... just...

An Attack.speaker: Context Narration
An Attack.dialogue: Against her own will, her body had forced her to finally fall asleep, laying slumped next to the mirror and basin, the tap still running loudly

An Attack.speaker: Context

An Attack.dialogue: I awaken in the morning before everyone else. I've somewhat recovered from what happened yesterday, even though I still have a noticable headache.

An Attack.dialogue: I get out of bed and look around as I see all the rest of the elite, all sleeping comfortably. I also notice Emilia and Joel, who where both curled together to stay warm

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Huh, I guess everyone fell asleep fine. What about Kyl...

An Attack.dialogue: I immediately rush towards Kyla, who was slumped on the floor with blood dripping from her forehead. I notice that the tap was off and the window was visibly cracked.

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: I'm able to turn her around, noticing her breathing becoming fainter by the second.

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: I pull out the world key and use it to heal her injuries as she remains asleep.

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Weird. Why would she injure herself like that. I would have heard if someone or something came in.

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Seems like we're almost at the city. Maybe we'll find Stan the-guhh.

An Attack.speaker: Narration
An Attack.dialogue: My headache seemed to spike again, causing me significant, but manageable pain.

An Attack.speaker: Jasmine
An Attack.dialogue: Well. If there's one thing Kyla was right about... I should probably get myself checked out by a medical expert

An Attack.speaker: Linda
An Attack.dialogue: ...Ughh, jeez. WHat the hell are you doing up so early, Jas

An Attack.dialogue: Ohh, Linda! Good morning. How you doing?

An Attack.dialogue: Could be better. Is your headache getting better?

An Attack.dialogue: Well... not really, but I'll be fine.

An Attack.dialogue: Well I guess she made that work. On the floor to... Whatever. Are we close to the city yet

An Attack.dialogue: Actually... yeah. Pretty sure I can see it in the...

An Attack.dialogue: It seemed to me like It came from the top deck.

An Attack.dialogue: You seem like you didn't sleep at all last night. Are you sure you're okay

An Attack.dialogue: Get up, you damn fool

An Attack.dialogue: ...we have enlisted the assistance of a Gourge Vindicator Syndicate. Please relenquish your ships of any valuables you may have if you would like to enter the city on the sea

An Attack.dialogue: Well... by what I can...

Accusation.dialogue: Another door, oppositely sided to the one we entered from, opened as the glass planes became glass again.

Accusation.speaker: Jasmine
Accusation.dialogue: Hey, Kyla. Where the hell does Havenus fit in all of that.

Accusation.dialogue: They were created long after the establishment of the 12 Sectors due to their disagreement with how Divinus functioned. I believe you will be able to find more information in the main museum if you are curious

Accusation.dialogue: Ohh yeah! were going into the museum.

Jack Merridew.dialogue: Ughh... Jasmine? Your alright? Well... that's a relief at lea...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jasmine
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Yeah, yeah, yeah, I'm okay, that's fine. WHAT HAPPENED TO YOU?

Jack Merridew.speaker: Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Racheal got up from the floor and dusted herself off before beginning to answer

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Well...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context
Jack Merridew.dialogue: While Jasmine was still asleep

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Racheal was fighting past the crowd looking for something to help out Jasmine

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: That nurse is definately not qualified, maybe I can find someone else that can help out Jasmine... Ohh, over there.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Racheal found a general purpose store and entered before asking if they had any medicine

Jack Merridew.speaker: Shop Owner
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Sorrt, ma'am. We don't have any as of now.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Ohh... well I can always check elsewhere

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: As she turned around to leave, she ended up bumping into someone

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Ohh, my apologies. I didn't see you ther...
Ahh, well look who it is...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: The person she bumped into wore an all black uniform suited for hunting, topped off with a hat with a star on it. Just looking at the figures face made Racheal begin to grip he spear closely to her as she was brought into a swift remembrance of them

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: ...Merridew

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Daww, wus wrong? Scared of little ol me, Racheal. Well, not like I was expecting us to ever met again, and here of all places.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: If that's the case, then I'll be on my way...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Woah, woah, woah, and end the reunion so quickly? Roger, get the rest of em. Tell em we found here

Jack Merridew.speaker: Roger
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Alright.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: As the rest of Jack group funnel in, Racheal begins to speak up to him

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: So this is what you did to the choir, turned it into your own personal hunting group. I can tell you never changed

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Says the one tightly gripping that little spear in their hands. Besides, there's still a beast there, something no one's ever seen on that island...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Do you HONESTLY believe that the really even was a beast there?

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Don't you?

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Excatly. We're going there to kill it and bring it back. Hunting a creature like that would earn us quite the fortune

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Enough with the excuses. You want to kill it simply because you can, don't you.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Roger turned to Jack, who was a bit more silent after that last line from Racheal, but Jack responded after a bit

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: What if I do simply just want to kill whatever it is. What if it's because I can. What does that even matter to you.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: ...I believe we're done here. Now we can simply move on fro...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Move on, huh.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Jack moved closer to her, puting one of his hands in his left pocket

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: You just want to move on from it, don't you. Move on from what WE did to Simon, and what happened to...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: In a fit of rage, Racheal swung her Spear to slash at Jack, to which he blocked with a Knife that he pulled out of his left pocket.

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: There it is. There's the fire. You still care about them, don't you

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: ...SHUT UP!

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Some members of Jacks group began to approach, but Jack stopped them

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Aww, what's wrong? Did I strike a nerve there?

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: Racheal had begun to raise her spear, but after some contemplation

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: She lowered her spear and pushed her way past Jack atteempting to exit the shop

Jack Merridew.speaker: Racheal
Jack Merridew.dialogue: I need to look for something that I could use to help Jasmi...

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: In a sudden burst of speed, Jack slashed her in the back with his knife before kicking her out of the shop and onto the ground

Jack Merridew.speaker: Context Narration
Jack Merridew.dialogue: After regaining her composure, Racheal prepared herself for battle

Jack Merridew.speaker: Jack Merridew
Jack Merridew.dialogue: There we go. Men, don't interfere, I'll deal with her myself

Reawakening.speaker: Jack Merridew
Reawakening.dialogue: Heh, that's the spirit. Didn't think you actually had some fight in you...

Reawakening.speaker: Context Narration
Reawakening.dialogue: Racheal had several injuries from her fight with Jack, while Jack, although also injured, was seemingly unphased

Reawakening.speaker: Jack Merridew
Reawakening.dialogue: ...Maybe if you used this violence, this strength, whenwe were there...

Reawakening.speaker: Racheal
Reawakening.dialogue: Shut... Up...

Reawakening.speaker: Jack Merridew
Reawakening.dialogue: ...Maybe he would still be alive.

Reawakening.speaker: Context Narration
Reawakening.dialogue: In furious rage, Racheal rushed directly towards Jack with her spear preped

Reawakening.speaker: Jack Merridew
Reawakening.dialogue: You see, that's your problem...

Reawakening.speaker: Context Narration
Reawakening.dialogue: In a swifter motion, Jack avoided her Spear strike and drove his knife into her neck.

Reawakening.speaker: Jack Merridew
Reawakening.dialogue: You care way to much about being normal in a world like this...

Reawakening.speaker: Context Narration
Reawakening.dialogue: Jack then kicked her away and cleaned his knife before leaving, with Roger close beside him

Reawakening.speaker: Jack Merridew
Reawakening.dialogue: Hide the body in the corner over there in that corner. Also, Roger, find anyone else with the same uniform as her. Maybe lead them here so that they know that they lost a...

Reawakening.speaker: Context Narration
Reawakening.dialogue: After a while of him talking, Racheal had finally passed out from the blood loss

Reawakening.speaker: Context
Reawakening.dialogue: Present time. Racheal skipped a few bits in her re-telling of the story

Reawakening.speaker: Racheal
Reawakening.dialogue: And that's about what happened

Reawakening.speaker: Jasmine
Reawakening.dialogue: So you're telling me that you found an old friend of your's called Jack while you were looking for resources to help me, he attacked you, you fought, and he killed you?

Reawakening.speaker: Racheal
Reawakening.dialogue: ...Yes.

Reawakening.speaker: Jasmine
Reawakening.dialogue: You know what, whatever. All that matters is that you're okay and you're here with us. We're looking for Macduf and Romeo.

Reawakening.speaker: Racheal
Reawakening.dialogue: Ohh yeah, they're outside right now looking for a boat. The port should be close by.

Reawakening.speaker: Jasmine
Reawakening.dialogue: Alright, let's...

Reawakening.speaker: Narration
Reawakening.dialogue: As I turn to leave, I notice that the wave of Shoppers are back again

Reawakening.speaker: Jasmine
Reawakening.dialogue: Ohh, you gotta be... You know what? Whatever... let's just go through them already...

Fire and Ice.speaker: Narration
Fire and Ice.dialogue: We finally make our way through the river of shooppers and outside of the plaza, where we find Stan waiting outside.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Stan
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Took you all long enough. Was getting tired of waiting.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Jasmine
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Stan? What are you doing here?

Fire and Ice.speaker: Stan
Fire and Ice.dialogue: Waiting for you? It's pretty obvious.

Fire and Ice.speaker: Jasmine
Fire and Ice.dialogue: You're suppose to be looking for Macduff and Romeo
